limitations: This is a distinct schedule-code view of the connected Mayer complex: the original176 bkey804 room polygons are reused unchanged. Existing MAYER layouts are not edited.
Only the seven keys found in the captured FA26 application feed are mapped; no new schedule keys are invented from room labels.
The six reviewed old-wing MAYER keys are removed from this separate Addition view because they belong to the MAYER schedule code.
The original bkey804 first-through-fourth-floor geometry is retained, including unscheduled spaces. No campus footprint is used to invent classroom geometry.
Level5 only models the room5623 region traced from the actual PDF. Its outline is partial, not a copy of the Level4 slab.
The fifth-floor approximate registration reuses independently checked repeated exterior walls from Level4; maximum held-out error is about1.02m.
Campus alignment is the existing approximate Facilities fit with low footprint overlap; it is not a surveyed registration. Geo CAAN is restricted to the official Addition6264.
EAP cover update date is2026, but the embedded legacy diagram revision is unknown. Recent renovations may not appear in these legacy boundaries.
